blocks.text: “Filipiñana,” “58th,” “Let Us Through, Dear Ancestors” (“Makikiraan Po”) and “Ria” are set to screen in different sections of the 31st Busan International Film Festival (BIFF) in South Korea. Rafael Manuel’s “Filipiñana” will screen in the A Window on Asian Cinema section, while Carl Joseph E. Papa’s “58th” will be featured in the Wide Angle – Documentary Showcase, as per the Film Development Council of the Philippines (FDCP). Meanwhile, Lav Diaz’s “Let Us Through, Dear Ancestors” (“Makikiraan Po”) will be part of the Icons section, and Arvin Belarmino’s “Ria” will screen under Vision Asia.
